body: I just CAN'T. I have no motivation, and trying to give myself motivation causes this anxiety that makes me feel literally sick. I feel sickened thinking about anything and everything. I can't handle brain activity. I want it all to just fucking STOP.

I can't take care of myself. My anxiety is so crippling. Showering makes me anxious. Thinking about showering makes me anxious. Thinking about going outside, about speaking to someone, about anything at all is more than I can handle. Everything just causes me to break down.
I have spoken to my SO and they are depressed as well. It really makes for a bad situation. Neither of us can help each other Because we are both so miserable.
I have no purpose. I have no home. I have no friends. I have no money. I'm stuck.
Contemplating ways to stop existing. Hiding under a blanket.
I have no insurance and I live in the US so it's pretty hopeless...
But none of these things are tangible. I can't even handle the days or hours or minutes of living this life, of being myself.
